pages.title: Chronon Field Inverter
pages.text: Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)chronon$() is a hypothetical quantum of time, proposed in the 1920s and never adopted by physics. The arrow of time, though, is real: entropy rises, and that is why the past differs from the future. This machine flips it locally and catches what falls out.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Solder, Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Gas, Chronosteel Ingot, Fractured Essence, Hawking Emitter.
